what: PDF Metadata Editor shows the hidden document details stored in a PDF and lets you change or remove them. These include the title, author, subject, keywords, the app used to create it, the PDF producer, the creation and last-changed dates, and the document language.

Metadata matters more than it seems: the title is often shown by browsers and search engines instead of the file name, and the author and app fields can reveal who made a file and with which software.
Changes are made with pdf-lib in your browser. The newer XMP metadata block, which many apps read first, is kept in step with your changes.
uses: Replace a title like "Microsoft Word - draft3.docx" with a proper document title.
Remove your name, company and software details before publishing a PDF.
Give a published PDF a clear title, subject and keywords.
Set the document language so screen readers pronounce it correctly.
Fix creation or change dates that are wrong after a conversion.
tutorial: Click the box or drop the PDF on it. Facts such as pages, file size, page size, PDF version and whether it has XMP metadata appear at the top.
Change Title, Author, Subject and Keywords. Leave a box empty to remove that detail.
Made with (app) and PDF producer show the software used. Change or clear them.
Created and Last changed are shown in your time zone. Pick new dates, clear them, or tick "Set Last changed to now".
Type a language code like en, fr-CA or ar, and tick the option to show the title in the reader’s title bar.
Custom properties such as Company are listed below. Edit, remove or add them with + Add property.
Press Save changes, or Remove all metadata to wipe all details at once. Then download the file.
features: Title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer, dates and language.
The XMP block is updated or removed together with the classic details.
View, edit, add and delete extra properties.
Dates are shown and saved in your time zone.

example.title: Worked example: cleaning a report before publishing
example.text: Nadia wants to publish annual-report.pdf. The editor shows the title "Microsoft Word - AR_final_v7.docx", her colleague’s name as author and a Company property. She types "Annual Report 2026" as the title, the organisation name as author, adds keywords, removes the Company property, ticks "Show the title" and presses Save changes. Browsers now show "Annual Report 2026" in the tab.

tips: Use Remove all metadata for files you share outside your organisation.
Separate keywords with commas so every app reads them the same way.
Some readers show the title only when "Show the title" is ticked.
The file name and the title are different things: rename the downloaded file too if needed.
problems: My changes do not show in a reader
Close and reopen the file; some readers cache document details.
Use a short code like en, de, pt-BR or zh-Hans, or leave the box empty.
Unlock the PDF with the Unlock PDF tool first.
